## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Identify whether data is measured, simulated, or derived.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Appropriate API or vision checks
- [ ] No secrets, runtime databases, or generated training outputs added
- [ ] Prototype limitations and changed API contracts documented

Hardware testing, if performed by the team, must state the exact setup and observations. Software checks do not prove electrical safety.
